test_kinematic_relationship_manager: test the KinematicRelationshipManager by initializing object-to-receptacle pairs and verifying parent-child relationships in a ReplicaCAD scene
initialize_from_obj_to_rec_pairs: create a KinematicRelationshipManager and initialize it from a mapping of object handles to receptacle names
apply_relations: run apply_relations on the KinematicRelationshipManager to propagate cached relative transforms after a parent object moves
remove_obj_relations: remove an object's parent relationship from the kinematic relationship graph and verify the tree updates correctly
add_relation: add a new parent-child kinematic relationship to the graph and verify the child is re-parented correctly
